morbi.headline: Morbi cluster faces export shocks and rising propane costs despite strategic solar investments.
what_changed: Ceramic exports dropped by Rs 3,589 crore over six months due to the Iran war.
Industrial propane gas prices in Morbi rose by Rs 3 to reach Rs 104 per kg.
Kajaria Ceramics acquired a 19.77% stake in Sunsure Solar for ₹1.21 crore.
stress_signals: Ceramic exports plummeted by Rs 3,589 crore due to geopolitical conflict in Iran [19f71f3185bc].
Propane prices escalated to Rs 104 per kg, dampening recovery prospects for tile makers [3d9aa30057b8, 9e8c549b7c05].
improvement_signals: Kajaria Ceramics invested ₹1.21 crore to acquire a stake in Sunsure Solar Park Twenty One Private Limited [a2787358932e].
what_to_watch: Monitor export recovery and order books for units heavily reliant on Middle Eastern markets.
Track further fluctuations in industrial propane gas prices and their impact on operating margins.
Evaluate local infrastructure representations made to the district minister regarding power and water.

surat.headline: Surat cluster exhibits mixed trends with textile payment defaults and diamond sector demand revival.
what_changed: Surat diamond units planned early reopenings or extended operations due to strengthening demand [bd78e4a130ff, e533595d0815].
Textile weavers and traders faced severe liquidity strains, protests, and payment defaults ahead of Diwali [774ba602b06e, e0787797133b].
SGCCI pursued export promotion via Morocco MoUs and demanded stringent legal measures against textile fraud [421d4bf835f5, 472a28abf217].
stress_signals: Weavers in Sayan zone planned a collective vacation cutting production by 60 crore meters amid financial distress [297b184838d2].
Outstanding textile payment dues exceeded 200 days, sparking protests by weavers ahead of Diwali [774ba602b06e].
Specific fraud and default cases emerged, including traders defaulting on jobworkers and merchant dues [f699b1f05b5e, 6a3068dc8bf1].
Diamond units faced pre-Diwali closures driven by rough diamond shortages despite demand [b65b93c4b724].
improvement_signals: Diamond units experienced rising demand, keeping factories operational through Dhanteras [e533595d0815].
Lab-grown diamond demand rose, prompting a 10% worker bonus [751cd1661531].
Textile PLI scheme criteria were relaxed with a 50% reduction in turnover thresholds and extension to FY 2033-34 [c7ee55f3effe].
what_to_watch: Monitor trade credit repayment cycles and realization of overdue receivables across weaving and trading accounts.
Track the operational stability and rough material availability for diamond cutting and polishing units post-vacation.
Observe execution timelines and actual export volume gains from the new Morocco MoUs.
Track utilization rates of the relaxed PLI scheme by eligible local textile manufacturers.
